messages:
Ana (Growth): Quick sync — we need a compact benchmark narrative for launch that ties tail latency to token unit economics. hero chart + two microcharts. webinar May 12. who can sketch messaging?
Josh (PM): Love +1. Hero should compare median vs 95th latency across models + cost/1k tokens on same x-axis. call out long-tail impact on UX. keep copy <2 lines.
Mira (Design): For the hero I can do a split-axis combo: latency line + cost bar. will label 95th with callouts. can we pick color palette (enterprise vs smb)?
Ben (Data): I can pull numbers from last three months. provisional numbers: median 120ms -> 80ms; 95th 520ms -> 180ms after optimizations; cost/1k down ~30% with batching/quant. need to confirm per-model variants.
Ana (Growth): perfect, Ben — send the CSV by end of day so we can iterate visuals. messaging drafts: "Reduce the 95th percentile latency by X to keep interactive flows snappy; cut token spend with smart batching." Thoughts?
Josh (PM): That draft works. Suggest we test two hooks: 1) "Faster, cheaper inference for real products" 2) "Keep your UX snappy without breaking the bank." Use A/B on webinar landing.
Mira (Design): Mocking up the hero now. Two microcharts beneath: small-multiple of latency distributions (SMB vs Enterprise) + cost sensitivity curve (tokens vs $). Sample spec: ```json
{
  "type": "combo",
  "hero": "95th_latency_vs_cost",
  "y": ["median_ms","95th_ms","cost_per_1k"],
  "annotations": ["95th callout","average cost delta"]
}
```
Mira (Design): Also adding tooltip copy for Azure/GCP region differences.
Ben (Data): CSV attached to thread (will DM secure link). quick note: enterprise workloads have heavier tails due to longer contexts; call that out as reason for Dedicated offering. data caveat: sample skews to chat workloads.
Ana (Growth): Messaging for routing leads: add two CTAs on the page — "Schedule a Dedicated consult" (for >95th threshold customers) and "Try hosted with Optimize" (for cost-sensitive). Capture a simple usage question on signup form: "Primary priority: latency / cost / both" so we can qualify.
Josh (PM): Love the qualification question. For webinar flow: run a quick 15-min demo of live latency charts + 10-min Q&A on routing & pricing. CTA in webinar: gated consult form -> sales triage + solutions engineering.
Mira (Design): I'll prepare slide templates that reuse hero chart and simplified 1:1 visuals for the demo. sending drafts by tomorrow. :thumbsup:
BenchBot: Created benchmark-chart PR #548 with placeholder data and Vega spec.
Ben (Data): I'll review PR tonight and add final numbers. expect edits to 95th annotations.
Ana (Growth): Good timeline. Final asks: Ben -> data CSV EOD, Mira -> first mock by tomorrow, Josh -> landing copy + CTA wording. I'll draft webinar signup copy and two email subject lines.
Josh (PM): I'll set up the A/B on the landing page and routing rules: if "latency" selected -> route to Dedicated workflow; else -> hosted nurture.
Ana (Growth): Thanks team — small deliverables, big impact. sync tomorrow if needed. :rocket:
